index_convention: ring and pos are 0-based indices into original JSON features[0].geometry.rings. For 1-based indexing add 1. Closing coordinate retained for geometry validity; removed from vertex search when identical to first coordinate. First and last distinct vertices are cyclic neighbors and excluded. Adjacent pairs excluded only within the same ring; cross-ring pairs searched as well. Positive planar Euclidean distance in input longitude/latitude degrees, not geodesic distance.
arcgis_limitation: This is GEOS validity and a degree-distance vertex search. It does not reproduce ArcGIS XY tolerance, resolution, clustering, or ArcGIS geometry validation.
